label: PHASE_R_DETECTOR_GENERALIZATION_DECISION

D2_holdout_eval_images.note: model.val() on labeled still images, threshold scan — not comparable to video inference

failure_taxonomy.L1: No detections on Paris canary — training distribution too narrow (38 V1 frames, single venue, early dates)
failure_taxonomy.D2: Training collapse: best_epoch=1, train_precision=0.003, uniform max_conf=0.013 on every frame. Model never learned discriminative features for diver vs background. Root causes: 32 training frames with ZERO hard negatives; possible learning rate or augmentation issues. SUPERVISOR CORRECTION: venue generalization failure is premature — model did not discriminate its own training examples.
failure_taxonomy.COCO: Detects spectators/background persons, NOT the target diver. High recall but wrong target.
failure_taxonomy.shared_root_cause: Single-venue training corpus. Insufficient frame count for discriminative learning. Diver appearance during flight phase differs significantly from general person appearance.

option_A.label: MORE_DATA_SAME_DOMAIN
option_A.description: Annotate 200-500 more frames from the single venue, including diverse apparatuses and dive phases.
option_A.expected_outcome: Better within-domain recall, unlikely to fix external generalization.
option_A.recommendation: PARTIAL — improves internal eval but does not address Paris canary failure.

option_B.label: EXTERNAL_DATA_MULTI_DOMAIN
option_B.description: Acquire dive footage from multiple venues (competitions, public pools, Paris-style pools). Add to training set.
option_B.expected_outcome: Addresses domain gap for external generalization.

option_C.label: ARCHITECTURE_CHANGE
option_C.description: Use pose estimation (MediaPipe, MoveNet) or segmentation-based localization instead of pure detection.
option_C.expected_outcome: Better generalization if person-skeleton is venue-agnostic.
option_C.recommendation: ALTERNATIVE — requires redesign but more principled.

option_D.label: SCENE_PRIOR_FILTERING_PLUS_LOWER_CONF
option_D.description: Use COCO at conf=0.05 + pool-corridor spatial prior to filter spectators.
option_D.expected_outcome: COCO fires on spectators in both venues; spatial filter might isolate diver region.
option_D.recommendation: TACTICAL — tested in Phase M (prior session). Spectator dominates at stationary cy ~0.5. Diver at flight (cy ~0.2-0.4) might be separable with spatial filter. Worth testing.

recommended_next_gate: Acquire minimum 200 frames from 2+ external venues before re-evaluation.
event_logic_status: V2.1 FROZEN — cannot evaluate on real Paris signal until perception prerequisite met.

supervisor_a1_correction.note: SUPERVISOR CORRECTION: Primary failure taxonomy revised from EXTERNAL_GENERALIZATION_FAILURE to D2_TRAINING_COLLAPSE_OR_SEVERE_UNDERFIT. Evidence: best_epoch=1, train_precision=0.003, max_conf=0.013 uniform on training images. A non-discriminative model cannot test venue generalization. Path forward changes: first diagnose and repair training pipeline before attributing failure to domain diversity.
